---
title: "Does a jury strut fix negative-g buckling, and what penalty does it cost?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 158.2      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

out = sbw_jury_strut_analysis(airplane)

p_comp_kn = float(out["P_comp_bal_kN"])
p_cr_0_kn = float(out["P_cr_0_kN"])
p_cr_jury_kn = float(out["P_cr_jury_kN"])
p_cr_clamp_kn = float(out["P_cr_jury_clamp_kN"])
l_sub = float(out["L_sub_m"])
l_strut = float(out["L_strut_m"])
overload_0 = float(out["overload_0"])
overload_jury = float(out["overload_jury"])
overload_clamp = float(out["overload_jury_clamp"])
n_buckle_0 = float(out["n_buckle_0"])
n_buckle_jury = float(out["n_buckle_jury"])
n_bays_req = float(out["n_bays_req"])
n_struts_req = n_bays_req - 1.0

m_jury_kg = float(out["m_j_total_kg"])
m_tubes_kg = float(out["m_j_tubes_kg"])
m_fittings_kg = float(out["m_j_fittings_kg"])
delta_cd_counts = float(out["delta_cd_counts"])
ld_base = float(out["ld_base"])
ld_jury = float(out["ld_jury"])
delta_ld = float(out["delta_ld"])
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{overload_jury:.0f}×"`]{.hero-value}
[ratio of negative limit compressive load to jury-braced Euler buckling capacity]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Adding a two-member jury strut halves the unbraced length to [`{python} f"{l_sub:.2f} m"`]{.key}, quadrupling Euler buckling capacity to [`{python} f"{p_cr_jury_kn:.2f} kN"`]{.key}. However, under the [`{python} f"{p_comp_kn:.1f} kN"`]{.key} compression identified in [negative limit analysis](2026-09-30-03-does-the-tension-sized-strut-buckle-under-the-jar-22-2-65g-negative-li.qmd), the strut remains overloaded by [`{python} f"{overload_jury:.0f}×"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{overload_clamp:.0f}×"`]{.key} clamped) and buckles at just [`{python} f"{n_buckle_jury:.3f}g"`]{.key} (@fig-jury-strut-trade). Preventing buckling requires [`{python} f"{n_bays_req:.0f}"`]{.key} bays ([`{python} f"{n_struts_req:.0f}"`]{.key} jury struts per wing). The jury truss adds [`{python} f"{m_jury_kg:.2f} kg"`]{.key} mass and [`{python} f"{delta_cd_counts:.2f}"`]{.key} drag counts, reducing best glide ratio by [`{python} f"{abs(delta_ld):.2f}"`]{.key} points.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **jury strut chord: 40 mm**, streamlined HQ010 composite blade.
2. **jury strut fittings: 1.0 kg**, hardware for both wings.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-jury-strut-trade
#| fig-cap: "Left: Critical Euler buckling load versus unbraced segment length comparing unbraced, jury-braced, and required multi-bay configurations against negative limit demand. Right: Glide polar comparison between baseline SBW and jury-braced SBW."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Buckling capacity vs unbraced column length
E_comp = 70e9
I_xx = 6667.8e-12
lengths = np.linspace(0.3, 5.0, 100)
p_cr_pin_curve = (np.pi**2 * E_comp * I_xx / lengths**2) / 1e3
p_cr_clamp_curve = (np.pi**2 * E_comp * I_xx / (0.5 * lengths)**2) / 1e3

ax1.plot(lengths, p_cr_pin_curve, color="crimson", lw=2.0, label="Pinned ($K=1.0$)")
ax1.plot(lengths, p_cr_clamp_curve, color="forestgreen", lw=1.8, ls="--", label="Clamped ($K=0.5$)")
ax1.axhline(p_comp_kn, color="darkred", ls="-.", lw=1.8, label=f"-2.65g Demand ({p_comp_kn:.1f} kN)")

ax1.scatter([l_strut], [p_cr_0_kn], color="crimson", s=50, zorder=5, label=f"Unbraced ($P_{{cr}}={p_cr_0_kn:.2f}$ kN)")
ax1.scatter([l_sub], [p_cr_jury_kn], color="navy", s=50, zorder=5, label=f"Jury-Braced ($P_{{cr}}={p_cr_jury_kn:.2f}$ kN)")
ax1.axvline(l_sub, color="navy", ls=":", lw=1.2)

ax1.set_xlabel("Unbraced Segment Length $L$ (m)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Critical Buckling Load $P_{cr}$ (kN)")
ax1.set_title("Euler Buckling Capacity vs Segment Length", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 35)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=7.5)

# Subplot 2: Glide polar comparison
speeds = out["speeds_kmh"]
ld_b = out["pol_base"]["LD"]
ld_j = out["pol_jury"]["LD"]

ax2.plot(speeds, ld_b, color="royalblue", lw=2.2, label=f"Baseline SBW (max L/D = {ld_base:.2f})")
ax2.plot(speeds, ld_j, color="darkorange", lw=2.0, ls="--", label=f"With Jury Strut (max L/D = {ld_jury:.2f})")

ax2.set_xlabel("Airspeed $V$ (km/h)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Glide Ratio $L/D$")
ax2.set_title("Glide Ratio Penalty from Jury Strut", fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="lower center", fontsize=7.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
